checks.label: Draw scale
checks.what_text_says: American magazines: reduction 'very frequently' to ~1/4 scale; England: drawing 'two-thirds to one-half' larger than block.
checks.what_is_inference: A1: drawScale default of 1.5 is curator midpoint of the English range. No single ratio stated in source. Text describes practice of its era, not a prescription.
checks.resolution_path: User must supply their own target reduction ratio; 1.5 is advisory only.

checks.label: Colour channel / blue guide
checks.what_text_says: Blue transfer paper preferred 'since blue will not photograph'. Reason is explicitly stated.
checks.what_is_inference: A2: Orthochromatic photographic process, 1894. Equivalence to RGB digital scanning or laser imaging is untested analogy. SVG guide-layer hue restriction is curator inference with no source support.
checks.resolution_path: Requires a source confirming that blue (#0000FF or similar) is excluded by the specific digital imaging process in use. Cannot be resolved by changing SVG properties alone.

checks.label: Openness / stroke gap
checks.what_text_says: Lines must not 'run together' after reduction; 'open' is the term used by process workers. Fine detail without thought for reduction gives 'dirty, meaningless patches'.
checks.what_is_inference: A3: minGapPx threshold is a placeholder — no number appears in source. SVG-DOM computability is non-trivial for variable-stroke-width tools; Theo's README correctly flags this as the primary interface to resolve.
checks.resolution_path: User must calibrate minGapPx against their actual output resolution. For pressure-sensitive pipelines, flatten strokes before applying check or downgrade to advisory.

checks.label: Sketch layer absent
checks.what_text_says: Pencil marks 'left in would probably print'; beginners 'should not... leave pencil marks in'. Erasing damages paper and dulls ink.
checks.what_is_inference: A4: The 1894 text has no layer concept. Mapping 'pencil marks left in' to a named SVG layer is entirely curator inference. The check is directionally sound but its interface (layer ID, naming convention) has no source grounding.
checks.resolution_path: Define and document your sketch-layer naming convention independently; the source cannot supply it.

minimum_evidence_needed_now: R2 is the only check that could actively mislead a user: a downstream pipeline relying on blue-exclusion as a digital-imaging guarantee has no source support. All other gaps produce advisory misconfigurations. R2 resolution requires a primary source on the digital imaging process in use, not a property of the 1894 text.
